create_distributed_model: create a DistributedModel wrapper to train a PyTorch module in distributed data parallel manner
train_distributed_model: call train on the DistributedModel to set the wrapped module stage to Stage.TRAIN
eval_distributed_model: call eval on the DistributedModel to set the wrapped module stage to Stage.TEST
get_state_dict: get the state dict of the wrapped module through the DistributedModel state_dict method
load_state_dict: load a state dict into the wrapped module through the DistributedModel load_state_dict method
